title: The fibre criterion for flatness in the Noetherian case
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states the fibrewise flatness criterion in the Noetherian case: for local maps of Noetherian local rings and a nonzero finite module that is flat over the base, flatness of the fibre modulo the maximal ideal forces the ring map and the module to be flat (statement lines 24194-24207). The proof does not quote the criterion: it compares the tensor products of the maximal ideal with the target, sets up the exact sequences relating the Tor groups of the module, of the fibre and of the ring map, obtains the needed vanishing, and concludes both flatness statements from the local criterion (proof lines 24209-24240). Arranging the Tor groups into one comparison is the step that carries the argument. H2.
